stories.title: She Checked on Her 'Loud' Upstairs Neighbor, Inspiring Strangers to Raise More Than $100,000
stories.label: people
stories.summary: Carole is an 87-year-old woman with Parkinson's disease who lives alone upstairs from a neighbor. That neighbor took the time to knock and check on her, and learned Carole needed far more help than anyone knew. Neighbors and total strangers rallied around her and raised more than $109,000. Carole discovered she was much less alone than she had thought.
stories.why_good: One small act of checking in on a neighbor grew into real, lasting support for an elderly woman, and it shows how much kindness is out there.

stories.title: Siblings Build 430-Step 'Sky Ladder' for Their Mother Who Refuses to Live in the City
stories.label: people
stories.summary: The grown children of an elderly mother in China built her a new staircase by hand up the side of a mountain, so she can get home more easily. She has refused to move to the city, and they wanted her to stay in the home she loves. Her youngest daughter remembers her mother holding the children's hands as they walked down the old mountain path. Now the children are helping her up that same mountain. The story has touched millions of people.
stories.why_good: A family finished a real, lasting project out of love, so a mother can stay in the home she wants.
